The Factory Tour Trail

What's on the Factory Tour Trail?

The Factory Tour Trail is a trail with 3 stops: Uncle Sam's All-American Chocolate Factory (Schenectady), Brewery Ommegang (Cooperstown) and Saranac Brewery (F.X. Matt) (Utica). Tip: Saturday is the day all three are open. Book the Saranac tour ahead (21+, 3, 4 or 5 p.m.), check hours before you go, and bring a designated driver.

Watch it get made, then taste it: chocolate in Schenectady, a Belgian-style brewery on an old hop farm, and one of the country's oldest family breweries.
